plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Exalt transmission device. It reports uptime, temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 25651).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Exalt internal temperature in degrees Celsius, read from locCurrentTemp under enterprise PEN 25651. The SNMP scalar is already in whole degrees, so the query does not scale it.

metrics.name: device_temp_alarm
metrics.description: Optional Exalt temperature alarm from locTempAlarm under enterprise PEN 25651. Values are almNORMAL(0), almMINOR(1) and almMAJOR(2). Some revisions omit this leaf; missing rows are skipped.

metrics.name: rsl_dbm
metrics.description: Exalt current received signal level in dBm, read from locCurrentRSL under enterprise PEN 25651. The SNMP scalar is already in whole dBm, so the query does not scale it. A dropping RSL is an early sign of path fade, antenna misalignment or radio degradation.

metrics.name: device_link_state
metrics.description: Optional Exalt microwave link alarm from locLinkState under enterprise PEN 25651. Values are almNORMAL(0) error-free, almMINOR(1) errored connection, and almMAJOR(2) no link. Some revisions omit this leaf; missing rows are skipped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
